purpose: Reproducible random candidate order and pre-conversion Level C fit decisions

population.definition: Numeric IDs with both problems/medium/<id>.md and problems/medium/solutions/text/<id>.md

draw.method: Sort IDs numerically, then shuffle with Python 3.13.5 random.Random(seed).shuffle
draw.policy: Review candidates in draw order. Record every considered candidate, including rejected and blocked sources. Convert ready accepted candidates until the requested total is reached.
draw.similarity_policy: Before conversion, compare each candidate's decisive reasoning and invariant with every active medium card and previously selected card in the same draw. Filter substantial duplicates even when the story or output differs.

reviews.collection_contribution: Adds weighted grid traversal and a proof that a seemingly path-dependent resource can be handled globally.
reviews.rationale: The free and unit-cost transitions and one-use portal rule leave substantial shortest-path reasoning beyond routine grid traversal.
